title: MACHINE-CONNECTIVITY-MS0
brief: Machine-floor connectivity. Three protocols: OPC-UA (PLC/HMI standard), MTConnect (CNC-specific), MQTT (IoT pub-sub). Extend the existing `OpcUaConnectorEngine` rather than re-implementing; build siblings for MTConnect + MQTT; one schema registry; one safety validator (every connector must declare which writes are allowed); one wiring unit. Lane-F continues here.
critical_path_role: machine-floor exposure (OPC-UA + MTConnect + MQTT); extends existing OpcUaConnectorEngine; closes the loop from shop-floor data → PRISM intelligence
